name: Knott's Berry Market Cold Strained Boysenberry Punch (Seed-Free)
whyItWorks: Knott's iconic purple boysenberry drink! Unlike raw whole boysenberries, this punch is 100% strained juice syrup and water, completely free of abrasive seeds and low in acid.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an ice-cold cup of Boysenberry Punch for refreshing, seed-free theme park hydration.
watchOuts: Contains natural fruit sugars; drink at a moderate pace
